findings.recommendation: Define claim-level outcomes and explicit record roll-up rules.
Make evidence adequacy auditable with claim, scope, locator, reviewer and conflict checks.
Separate internal staging from learner-visible publication and restrict meaning-affecting P2 issues.
Define accountable qualified human safety approver; AI agreement cannot clear P0.
Define revision, supersession, conflict and re-check rules.
Align claim evidence requirements with entity_sources and extend or scope QA view coverage.
Require asset-level license evidence, attribution, access date and redistribution permission.
Define independent review, preserve both reviews and evidence-based reconciliation.
Prohibit invented enum values and route unrepresentable concepts to owner-approved schema proposal.
Define re-review triggers and append-only review history.

confirmed_strengths: DTC and symptom are not proof of component failure
AI consensus and JSON validity are not technical verification
Correct distinction between review date and import/generation date
Owner approval before canonical production changes
non_actions: No production data or schema changed
